verdict.rationale: Medusa's pricing page lists "Background workers" and "Webhook Events", and the homepage promises you can "extend, customize, and own every commerce workflow." A community comment confirms background workers process jobs from a Bull queue outside the request lifecycle. This shows background job execution exists, but the evidence is only feature-list labels, with no documentation of how a user sets up automations to run on their own. Missing for 10: documented scheduled jobs or event-triggered automation setup, docs on workflow and subscriber configuration, any AI-agent-driven background automation, and hands-on corroboration beyond a single comment.
